title: Complement closure of bounded-error computation
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model closed under Boolean negation: whenever it regards a Boolean verifier as efficient, it also regards the verifier that negates every answer as efficient. If a language $L$ belongs to the bounded-error class defined using $E$, then its complement also belongs to that class.
hypotheses_covered: A verifier model $E$ closed under Boolean negation of efficient verifiers
A language $L$ in the bounded-error class defined using $E$
